title: GOOSE environment reproduced on Windows from a clean machine
dataset: GOOSE 3D validation split, archive downloaded 2026-08-22 from goose-dataset.de
sensor_configuration: Velodyne Alpha Prime 128-channel roof LiDAR only, as distributed in the annotated archive
annotation_schema: GOOSE 64-class pointwise semantic labels, SemanticKITTI .label format
split: validation, smoke test on one frame of 961

environment.hardware: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660, 6144 MiB VRAM; driver 560.94; CUDA runtime 12.6

measurements.name: frames discovered
measurements.scope: smoke test, matches the macOS run

notes: Evidence for acceptance criterion P-5: a person outside the original setup reproduced a documented result from a clean machine. Stronger than a second macOS reproduction would have been, because the tooling was written and tested on Apple Silicon and this is a genuinely different OS. Also disproved risk R-08's premise that no team member has a discrete NVIDIA GPU. Whether 6 GiB suffices for Pointcept/PTv3 is a separate open question. The dataset copy was deleted after measurement to free disk ahead of an OS reinstall, so re-running this on the same machine requires re-downloading.
